correctness.rationale: For any char-2 field and A=k[x,y]/(x²,y²), all derivations form A∂x⊕A∂y, alternating biderivations are A(∂x∧∂y), and alternating triderivations vanish. The bracket g=a+bx+cy+dxy has δ0(h)=g(h_y∂x+h_x∂y), δ1(X,Y)=g(X_x+Y_y)+Xg_x+Yg_y. Direct column rank by a,b,c,d strata gives (rank δ0,rank δ1)=(0,0),(2,2),(3,3), hence Betti triples (4,8,4),(2,4,2),(1,2,1). For g=dxy, the four linear vector fields have only two nonzero wedge products ps=qr=xyη; off the socle, normal forms 1+dxy and x+dxy each admit degree-1 generators whose product is nonzero xyη, yielding Λ(P,Q). Finite-field bracket multiplicities 1,q-1,q^4-q follow from parameter count. Independently built F2 cochain maps for all 16 g, checking ranks and δ1δ0=0; independently inspected verify_ring.py code also ranges GF2/4/8. The arbitrary-field proof is explicit rank/product algebra.
